relatedParty.note: BHFL sells (assigns) loan pools to its parent Bajaj Finance and keeps servicing them for a fee; the 2026 AGM sought omnibus approval for up to ₹12,500 cr of such transfers. Assignment keeps the housing-share (PBC) ratios above the floor and generates 'income on derecognised loans'.

mps.bulkDeal: 2-Dec-2025: BFL sold 16.66 cr shares (~2%) via a bulk deal; stake 88.70% → 86.70%; stock fell ~9% to a then-record low of ₹94.90 that day
mps.deadlineNew: 15-Sep-2029, after the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Amendment Rules, 2026 (13-Mar-2026) revised the market-cap thresholds
mps.toSell: 11.70% of shares (~97.5 cr shares) to reach 75%
mps.parentView: 'We will go down to 75%, while we have time and we are in no hurry. First protocol most likely will be BHFL dilution' (Rajeev Jain, BFL Q1FY27 call, 30-Jul-2026); BFL shares part of its gains on BHFL sales with its own shareholders (BFL Q4FY26 call)
